title: oenothera biennis f. argillicola
intro: Oenothera biennis f. argillicola, commonly known as evening primrose, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the willowherb family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been traditionally used to alleviate various health issues. The health benefits of Oenothera biennis f. argillicola include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve skin conditions, and support cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gamma-linolenic acid (GLA), a polyunsaturated fatty acid with therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and calm the body.
